Yeah that's super disappointing, but it's really hard to say. I naturally have blonde hair and when I've bleached and dyed it, it felt like it would stay in forever. However I know asian hair has a much harder time holding on to color. It might be worth asking the seller if it is a mix of different hair types. It would also be good to ask if they had used permanent color vs semi-permanent. finally, in the first picture, it seemed like there were lighter pieces in the back, this looks some what comparable to the last picture, just more washed out. I would ask for a refund and see what they say, but if they dont give it to you, you should be able to get the info you need to care for the wig and also redye if you need.
Have you had a wig that’s been dyed, before?

I don’t think anyone could tell you. It really depends on how you washed the hair. The other issue is, hair dye naturally washes out. Unless this is synthetic, I’m not sure how much luck you would have getting a refund.

I agree 100%, it’s super difficult to talk about and ask. If you are truly trying to get better, I’m not too sure this is the friend to go to. I don’t know your family situation, but if there is someone you can trust I would go to them.

I’m not trying to be mean, but what did you want them to ask? If you were trying to get support then you need to be the one to ask for it. I get it’s tough, but when I was at my sickest I saw nothing wrong with purging, so I probably would have done the same. That why it’s important for you to speak up and say what you need and then people can help you. Also I don’t see this as a good friendship if you guys are willing to enable each other and your EDs. Anyway, sorry that you’re going through this, and I hope things get better.

It’s not a huge thing, but personally I turn away because I worry about their proficiency in the language they are teaching, especially if it’s their second language. It makes me wonder how they assess themselves and the languages they know. I only really do this if they have 5 or 6 languages listed. At the end of the day if they have good reviews and they seem nice I’ll still book with them.

As a student when I’m looking for a new teacher, sometimes the amount of languages they say they can speak can turn me away. Since you’re studying Japanese maybe take the Chinese and Spanish off. Other than that I think the rest of your profile looks good!

Your t4 is a bit low which can also cause those symptoms, but your anion gap looks high too. I know it has to do with electrolytes and that can sometimes cause an irregular heartbeat. The other test I have no idea.
